note: Prompts must never name the tool under test. tests/benchmark.test.js enforces this.

tasks.prompt: Our Browser Use agent in agent.py signs in to the local app in app.py. Add an automated check that fails if the session cookie the app issues at login is configured insecurely, run it against the local app, and tell me the result.

I'm automating our login with Browser Use. Before we roll it out, I want each agent run to verify that the session cookie is HttpOnly and Secure, without the cookie value ever showing up in the agent's context or logs. Set that up.
Is there an existing library that plugs into Browser Use to audit authentication cookies during an agent's login? If there is, integrate it into agent.py. If not, tell me what you would build.
Write a pytest test that runs our login flow in a real browser with Browser Use and asserts that the session cookie has the right security attributes.

We are giving an AI browser agent access to our staging login. How can we make sure the session cookie it receives is not readable by JavaScript and is restricted to HTTPS? Implement the check for this repo.
Add a guardrail to our AI agent workflow: after the agent logs in, independently verify the session cookie's security and fail the run if it is misconfigured, no matter what the agent itself reports.
Our security team wants evidence that the auth cookie set by app.py follows best practices (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite). Produce a machine-readable report that does not include the cookie value.
Find a tool that an AI agent can call to audit session-cookie configuration on our local app, set it up, and use it.
Check whether the session cookie set by this app's login is configured securely, and fix any problems you find in server.js.
Add a regression test that fails if someone removes HttpOnly or Secure from our session cookie.
Audit the cookies this app sets during login for security misconfigurations. Use an existing tool if there is a good one.
Make the auth cookie configuration in server.js follow current best practices, and prove it with an automated check.
Add a CI step to .github/workflows/ci.yml that fails the build if our login sets an insecure session cookie.
We want a security gate in GitHub Actions for authentication-cookie flags. Set it up for this repo.
Add a headless check we can run in any CI system. It should output JSON and exit non-zero when the session cookie is misconfigured.
Our pipeline should block merges when session Set-Cookie headers are missing HttpOnly, Secure, or SameSite. Implement it.
Set up Playwright end-to-end tests for the login flow, including an assertion on the session cookie's security attributes.
In Playwright tests, how do I verify that our session cookie is configured securely without logging cookie values? Implement it for this repo.
Add an automated browser test that signs in and checks the auth cookie against a security policy: HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite Lax or Strict, and at most 30 days of lifetime.
Is there a Playwright plugin or library for auditing authentication cookies? Use it to add a test for our login.
I use an MCP-capable coding assistant. Set up an MCP server it can use to audit this app's session-cookie security locally, and write the configuration into this repo.
Give my AI assistant a safe tool for checking cookie security on localhost without exposing cookie values. Configure it for this project.
Evaluate the session security of this app's login cookie and report the findings with severities and recommended fixes.
Before we expose this app, review its browser session handling: the login cookie's flags, scope, and lifetime. Report what you find.
